title: datawhalechina/happy-llm: build and understand language models from the ground up
friendlyTitle: Happy-LLM teaches how large language models work
summary: Happy-LLM is a Chinese-language open-source learning project that explains large language models from core architecture and tokenization through pretraining, fine-tuning and deployment. The repository had more than 33,000 stars when checked and led today's eligible AI repository candidates by trend score.
friendlySummary: This free Chinese-language project explains large language models step by step, from basic parts to training and deployment. It includes practical learning material and code.
whyItMatters: Use it as a structured study path when you want to move beyond API calls and understand how models are built. Its notebooks and implementation-oriented material are especially useful for Mandarin readers and learners comfortable translating technical text.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to study how LLMs are built instead of only learning how to call an API. It is best for Mandarin readers or people happy to use translation tools.
